en: Growth and comfort never coexist.
zh: 成长和舒适不可兼得。

en: And if you're gonna grow as a person, as a leader.
zh: 如果你想作为一个人、作为一名领导者不断成长，

en: you gotta get comfortable with being uncomfortable.
zh: 你就必须习惯那种不舒服的状态。

en: You welcome challenge, you welcome risk.
zh: 你要欢迎挑战，也要拥抱风险。

en: because you know you come out better at the other side.
zh: 因为你知道，经历过之后，你会变得更好。

en: I was born and raised in Chicago, Illinois.
zh: 我在伊利诺伊州芝加哥出生并长大。

en: and I think I was always the one that was sort of the mother hen of my brothers and sisters.
zh: 我觉得我一直都是兄弟姐妹里那个像大姐姐一样照顾大家的人。

en: Most of my memories are of taking care of them in one way or another.
zh: 我大多数记忆，都是以这样或那样的方式照顾他们。

en: I really loved school.
zh: 我真的很喜欢上学。

en: I was always good in math.
zh: 我数学一直很好。

en: I loved this idea that you should be able to derive where everything comes from.
zh: 我很喜欢一种想法：你应该能够推导出每件事的来龙去脉。

en: But I did a lot of activities.
zh: 不过我也参加了很多活动。

en: I played basketball, volleyball, and I was student council president.
zh: 我打篮球、打排球，还当过学生会主席。

en: In that moment, our world changed.
zh: 就在那个时刻，我们的世界改变了。

en: We went on food stamps.
zh: 我们开始靠食品券生活。

en: and my mother felt ashamed to have to do something like that.
zh: 我母亲因为不得不这样做而感到羞愧。

en: And I can remember that pain in her eyes, but she was determined
zh: 我还记得她眼里的那种痛苦，但她非常坚定，

en: that this would not be how this story ended.
zh: 她绝不会让我们的故事就这样结束。

en: She went back to school, got a job, then got a better job,
zh: 她重新回到学校，找到了一份工作，然后又找到了一份更好的工作，

en: a better job, and I watched my brothers and sisters.
zh: 再后来又换了更好的工作，而我则照看我的弟弟妹妹们。

en: It was one of the most defining elements of my life.
zh: 那是我人生中最重要、最能塑造我的经历之一。

en: and we all learned you never let someone else define who you are.
zh: 我们也都学会了，绝不能让别人来定义你是谁。

en: Only you define who you are.
zh: 只有你自己能定义你是谁。

en: I'll often meet people and they'll say, hey, I was with you in class.
zh: 我经常会遇到一些人，他们会说，嘿，我以前和你一起上过课。

en: I'm like, that's interesting, I'm sorry, I'm embarrassed.
zh: 我就会说，这很有意思，真不好意思，我有点尴尬。

en: I don't remember you, but there was like 30 of you and one of me,
zh: 我不记得你了，但当时你们有三十来个人，而我只有一个，

en: so you probably remember me.
zh: 所以你可能更容易记住我。

en: It was just not the norm.
zh: 那在当时真的不是常态。

en: I came from no money, no anything to go to a great school,
zh: 我一无所有、家里没什么钱，却一路走进了一所很好的学校，

en: and it's really, though, why I do feel so strongly that in this country,
zh: 也正是因为这样，我才会如此强烈地相信，在这个国家，

en: where there is a will, there is a way to get something done.
zh: 有志者事竟成。

en: 10 years into my career, I had been offered a promotion.
zh: 工作十年后，我得到了一次晋升机会。

en: The man who had offered it said, look, you should take my job,
zh: 给我这个机会的那位男士说，听着，你应该接替我的职位，

en: and I said, oh, I'm not ready for this thing yet.
zh: 而我说，哦，我还没准备好接这个职位。

en: Just give me a little bit more time.
zh: 再给我一点时间吧。

en: I went home that night and my husband looked at me and he said,
zh: 那天晚上我回到家，我丈夫看着我说，

en: do you think a man would have answered the question that way?
zh: 你觉得一个男人会这样回答这个问题吗？

en: No. So I went back in the next day, I took the job,
zh: 不会。所以第二天我又回去了，接受了那份工作，

en: and he looked me in the eye and he said, don't do that again.
zh: 他看着我的眼睛，对我说，别再这样了。

en: I said, I understand.
zh: 我说，我明白了。

en: To lead IBM, I mean, wow.
zh: 领导 IBM，说真的，哇。

en: it is with great gratitude and a great sense of responsibility.
zh: 我怀着巨大的感激，也怀着强烈的责任感。

en: But I didn't want the world to define me as the first woman CEO of IBM.
zh: 但我不希望世界把我定义为 IBM 的第一位女性 CEO。

en: I just wanted to be a good CEO of IBM.
zh: 我只想成为一名优秀的 IBM CEO。

en: It was another pivotal learning point that you do have to recognize you are a role model,
zh: 这又是一个关键的学习时刻：你确实必须意识到，自己是一个榜样，

en: that for people to aspire to be something, it does really help
zh: 因为人们想要追求某种目标时，确实会很有帮助，

en: if they see other people around them that are in that role,
zh: 如果他们能看到身边有人已经处在那个位置，

en: and therefore take that seriously.
zh: 所以你也必须认真对待这件事。

en: This era, I believe, will reflect back on, data will be the issue of our time,
zh: 我相信，当我们回望这个时代时，会发现数据将是我们这个时代的核心议题，

en: and handled with care, you will solve some of the world's most intractable problems,
zh: 如果谨慎地处理数据，你就能解决世界上一些最棘手的问题，

en: and that's behind all our investment in artificial intelligence and cloud.
zh: 这也是我们所有人工智能和云计算投资背后的原因。

en: The most important thing you have to do is have conviction about what you believe is right and then stay your course.
zh: 你最重要要做的事，就是对你认为正确的事情保持信念，然后坚定地走下去。

en: When I think about women in the workplace, it's about inclusion.
zh: 当我想到职场中的女性时，核心是包容。

en: I do believe it's a company's job to create a good environment for that.
zh: 我确实相信，公司有责任为此创造一个良好的环境。

en: Companies, they will take everything you can give.
zh: 公司会拿走你能付出的一切。

en: So you have to set your boundaries, and that's what gives you your balance.
zh: 所以你必须设定自己的边界，而这才会给你带来平衡。

en: And I guarantee you, most things adapt around them.
zh: 我可以向你保证，大多数事情都会围绕这些边界慢慢适应。

en: And so I think the state, the focus on that, of how to advance women,
zh: 所以我认为，关于如何推动女性发展，

en: it is a constant.
zh: 这件事必须持续关注。

en: It isn't about one moment.
zh: 它不是某一个瞬间的事情。

en: This is about continuity and about persistence.
zh: 它关乎持续性，也关乎坚持。

en: That is what will solve this problem.
zh: 这才是解决这个问题的方式。

en: There is no doubt in my mind.
zh: 我对此毫不怀疑。

en: that attracting women and great people in general has to do with your values and you live them.
zh: 吸引女性，以及吸引优秀的人才，本质上取决于你的价值观，以及你是否真正践行它们。

en: You live them every day.
zh: 你要每天都践行这些价值观。

en: Not what you say, it's what you do.
zh: 重要的不是你说什么，而是你做什么。
